llmJudgeRequirements.description: Query is stored with React `useState`, and deferred query is derived with React `useDeferredValue`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: query is stored with useState('') and deferredQuery is derived via useDeferredValue(query)

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Data loading runs in React `useEffect` with deferred query in the dependency list, performs `fetch(...)` from that deferred value
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useEffect inside useProducts has [query] in its dependency list; the hook is called with deferredQuery, so the effect runs on deferredQuery changes and calls fetch(url) built from that value

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Data loading commits loading then ready/error status transitions
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Effect sets loading=true and error=null before fetch, then on success sets products and loading=false, and on error sets error message and loading=false

llmJudgeRequirements.description: UI renders stale-results indicator when urgent and deferred values differ, with urgent value controlled by `TextInput` and deferred results rendered through `FlatList`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: isStale = query !== deferredQuery; when true, '(updating…)' text is appended and listWrapper gets opacity:0.5 via styles.stale; TextInput controls query and FlatList renders products from deferredQuery
